acceptance: A research, decision or task item routed console-manual gets no lane reroute proposal
An item with no named files gets no lane reroute proposal
fix: The reroute rule also needs a buildable kind (bug, fix, techdebt, refactor, hardening, test, pipeline-repair, security), at least one named file, and no open PR that names the item. Put the kind set in policy data, not code. Then measure the proposals over one boundary and decide the move to enforce.
source: console, 2026-11-12, pipeline health investigation: supply 2 admissible of 506, 320 console_route
summary: evolve inbox curate (stage shadow) proposes 89 console-to-lane reroutes. Its one rule is: no protected fix surface and no pipeline kind. That rule also passes research, decision, task and design-question items, which a lane cannot finish well, and items whose work already has an open PR (AD2-7 has #1269). So the proposals cannot be applied as a set, and the curator stays in shadow while the lane supply starves.
title: The inbox curator proposes a lane reroute only for a buildable kind that names its files
